title: The rehearsal swallows an evening-composition failure and still says 'you're ready'
method: read of both renderers + injected raise through the real _preview
observed_at_discovery: cura/__main__.py:170-179 and cura/setup/preview.py:32-39 both wrap compose_evening in a bare `except Exception: evening = []` and omit the evening section; _preview then prints "If that sounds right, you're ready." regardless. Observed: with compose_evening raising, _preview emitted a morning-only script and the ready line, and preview_lines returned only the morning heading. The rehearsal is the caregiver's ONLY evidence the product works, and a morning-only script is indistinguishable from a household with no evening medications. Also observed: _preview does not call preview_lines at all, so the terminal and the window render from two separate copies — the exact drift preview.py's own docstring says it exists to prevent. I did not find a natural config that makes compose_evening raise; the swallow is observed, its natural trigger is not. pytest exit 1, 2 failed.
